# gitmoap_issue_criterion_kinds (Data Source)

The catalogue of acceptance-criterion kinds and their argument field schemas. Lists every kind of acceptance criterion — `manual`, `test`, `metric`, `coverage`, `node` and `scorecard_check`, which is filed automatically and cannot be authored — each with a label, help text, its typed argument fields and a JSON Schema for them, enough to build one authoring form per kind. The catalogue is the same for everyone, and any signed-in caller may read it.

The token needs `issue:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_issue_criterion_kinds" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `kinds` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kinds))

<a id="nestedatt--kinds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kinds`

Read-Only:

- `config_schema` (String) A JSON Schema over the fields — render a form from this.

JSON: set it with `jsonencode()`.
- `description` (String)
- `evaluable` (Boolean) Whether the platform evaluates this kind from evidence (i.e. it is a real binding, not a
manual checkbox).
- `fields` (Attributes List) The typed argument fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kinds--fields))
- `kind` (String) A kind of acceptance criterion. `Manual` is a human-ticked checkbox (no binding); the
rest bind to a predicate the platform evaluates from pipeline evidence.
- `label` (String)
- `proved_by` (String) What proves a criterion of this kind. `person`: someone ticks it. `step_outcome`: whether a pipeline step succeeds, which needs nothing more than the step. `test_reports`: a test report a step writes — JUnit XML, cargo-nextest JSON, go test -json or CTRF. `coverage_reports`: an LCOV, Cobertura or Go coverage report. `measurements`: a measurement a step writes as gitmoap.evidence/v1. `scorecard`: a service-catalog check.

<a id="nestedatt--kinds--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kinds.fields`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `field_type` (Attributes) The type of a criterion-kind field, which decides the form control that suits it.

`type` says which applies: `text`; `glob`; `number`, with `max`, `min`; `choice`, with `options`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kinds--fields--field_type))
- `label` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `required` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--kinds--fields--field_type"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kinds.fields.field_type`

Read-Only:

- `max` (Number)
- `min` (Number)
- `options` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kinds--fields--field_type--options))
- `type` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--kinds--fields--field_type--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kinds.fields.field_type.options`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String)
- `value` (String)
